review:
A free spins game, not a Hold the Jackpot one, which makes it a nice change in Wazdan's line-up. The Collector symbol is the star: it gathers values from Bonus symbols throughout Free Spins and pays the total at the end.

Collect to Infinity upgrades a Collector so it keeps collecting for the rest of the round, and that's where the 4,000x max win comes from. Cash Out adds more chances to win in the base game, and Chance Level's three options make Free Spins easier to trigger. Very high volatility, 96.11% RTP. Expect long quiet spells, then a bonus that can snowball.
pros: Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
